_comment: Copy to config.json and edit. Every key is optional — defaults live in loomy2api/config.py. Environment variables override this file (see README).
_access_key: Leave empty to use the constants shipped with the official client. Override if your client ships a different pair.
_proxy: empty = direct. socks5://, http://, or https://user:pass@host:port. SOCKS5 resolves names at the proxy. Editable from the panel.
_api_keys: empty list = no auth (fine on localhost). Set e.g. ["sk-abc"] to require Bearer/x-api-key on the model API and a login page on /panel. The panel session cookie is not accepted on /v1.
_models: Upstream model ids are used verbatim — no alias table. See GET /v1/models for the catalogue.
_pool: accounts_file holds your accounts (gitignored). strategy: balance | round_robin | lru
_identity: per_account = each account gets its own devid + promotions device id, bound on first login; client = mirror the shipped client exactly (devid: web)
